contract.fullContract:
# G28 compiler-private append-only compact rows

Baseline R12 source5916d410 restored3167aea6; rejected G27 removed. Do NOT reintroduce G25/G26/G27 source optimizations incidentally. Parent integrates and alone runs all generators/builds/tests/smokes/performance. Existing untracked57 files are user-owned. Agents skip builds/lint/tests/formatters/generators. No repository docs; concise local notes allowed.

## Measured target
Full unchanged R12 source arena:2,254,791 distinct Node objects,capacity4,194,304;828,514 distinct Span objects (shared2.72:1). Actual V8 sample Node shallow sizes32–88B, tag-weighted extrapolated137,560,752B Node bodies, excluding array/header/descendants. Span56B/sample; KEEP span references/shared leaves, do not flatten or clone spans. Native Node is BOX, separate class-rounded payload per node; spans are3inline words natively, so JS and C codecs differ. Full census passed checking; optional full snapshot hit unchanged8GiB guard. Small actual R12 sample snapshot succeeded. No speedup assumed.

## Goal and scope
Replace ONLY persistent checker Array<Node> with one opaque compiler-private append-only row store. Keep Node as ephemeral decoded Data, not store-backed views. No persistent old Node array or hidden mirror/cache. Keep all other lanes, counts/depth metadata, source/transient ID tags, Mark, publication/readback and diagnostics unchanged. Backend implementation generic, NOT hard-coded to Node names/root/fixtures. No runtime type reflection dependency: actual boxed value identifies layout on C; actual JS record tag/keys identifies schema on JS. Public Base.Array untouched.

## Exact Base API (parent adds declarations)
law CompilerRows: for -T: Data; Type
law CompilerRows.new: for -T: Data; for +depth: Nat; for +zero: T; CompilerRows(T)
law CompilerRows.get: for -T: Data; for rows: CompilerRows(T); for +index: U32; CompilerRows(T) & T
law CompilerRows.append: for -T: Data; for rows: CompilerRows(T); for value: T; CompilerRows(T)
law CompilerRows.grow: for -T: Data; for rows: CompilerRows(T); CompilerRows(T)
law CompilerRows.rewind: for -T: Data; for rows: CompilerRows(T); for +target: U32; CompilerRows(T)
Use normal checked Base-origin native law admission. T erased. CompilerRows is affine opaque family, no constructors/extraction/Array compatibility. All direct/first-class/partial paths required. Parent owns Base, checker_arena migration, fixtures, generated runtime/source/pins, runner/evidence/docs/commits.

new(depth,zero): empty store used0, slot capacity2^depth, default zero returned for all unwritten slots. Reject depth>31 BEFORE narrowing/allocation with existing array-depth error (incl computed Nat2^32). zero is retained owned Data. get masks index modulo slot capacity, returns same affine owner and an independent Data value; no mutable/borrowed view. append consumes/stores value as next slot, growing slots once if full (parent NodePool already calls grow when full; must not double-grow). grow doubles SLOT capacity without changing used or values/default, rejects old depth31. rewind target<=used drops discarded references, resets payload/ref cursors, clears discarded headers to default; invalid target>used must fail-stop without corruption. Reuse after rewind must never observe stale payload. No extra lookup/clamping beyond these declared new-API invariants.

## Representations
JS: flat Uint32Array slot tag/schema IDs and payload offsets; append-only Uint32Array variable record payload, with reference side array. NO fixed max-arity payload per slot. Cache schema (nominal tag+ordered fields and reconstruction) per record variant, not per node; do not Object.keys on every get. Encode exact integer fields0..2^32-1 as U32; all other values (wide Nat/other numbers/strings/objects/quantity/spans) retained exactly in reference side pool, with record bitmask distinguishing U32 vs reference indices. Do not narrow wide Nat. Support any arity with ceil(fields/32) mask words, not a silently capped31-field format. Atomic/native values can use an explicit raw-value schema. Decode one independent value with original nominal tag and fields; backend-specific Tuple convention preserved. References may share Span/List/String objects; persistent Node itself must not be retained. Geometric growth, truncation clears refs; default/tag0 slack. Use payload offsets/cursors as full U32 within existing block bounds; never pack tag into offset bits. Allocation failure must be real, no shadow-array fallback.
U32 classification MUST exclude Object.is(value, -0); negative zero is retained exactly through the cold-reference path, preserving F32.bits(0x80000000).

C: use existing Bend heap/block allocator and ordinary Term ownership/drop infrastructure, NEVER new malloc heap. Store per-slot constructor/raw-kind and offsets in packed BUF lanes; append existing constructor payload words contiguously in ARR (Term-cell) payload tape. Use existing cid_arity/ctr_take/refcount operations to consume original boxed constructor without losing/copying references incorrectly. All payload words remain original64-bit Term-safe words: NO packing2U32 into a Term word (breaks rfc_seal/term_drop). No old Node box retained for TAG_CTR rows. Explicit raw-kind stores one whole value for native/immediate/other non-constructor values; decode preserves all bits. get reconstructs original constructor with its original CID/arity and shared children; raw/default get performs required term_keep. Container is an owned ordinary ARR/constructor of its BUF/payload/default children so closure drop releases everything with existing term_drop. Slot/payload geometric growth copy ownership exactly once; rewind drops every discarded child once and clears slots; capacity/used/cursor arithmetic checked against existing block bounds BEFORE shifts. Device qualifiers/shared-runtime conventions unchanged. Direct intrinsic get may return raw T and emitter constructs declared tuple; generic path layouts must agree.

## Work ownership
Canonical agent: bend2/comp.ts ONLY (C+JS primitives, runtime helpers, ownership, family handling, direct/native value paths).
Selfhost agent: backend_ir.bend, lower_catalog.bend, backend_lower.bend ONLY if necessary, c_backend.bend, c_backend_layout.bend ONLY if necessary, c_backend_physical.bend, c_backend_sharing.bend, js_backend.bend. Runtime helpers generated from canonical comp.ts by parent; call the SAME C helper symbols and implement equivalent JS helpers. Coordinate names/tuple convention with canonical author. Do not edit c_runtime.c/evals/gen_c_runtime.ts or checkpoints.
C op keys compilerrows_new/get/append/grow/rewind; runtime helper names compiler_rows_new/get/append/grow/rewind; BIR PrimCompilerRowsNew/Get/Append/Grow/Rewind. New arguments depth,zero (T erased); get rows,index; append rows,value; grow rows; rewind rows,target. C raw get returns Term, new/append/grow/rewind return Term; tuple wrapping done by emitter with exact declared CompilerRows(T)&T layout. JS get helper may return own backend Tuple convention consistently.

## Qualification and fail-fast
Independent adversarial contract/final code review. Parent exercises generic stored records including every missing Node variant, wide Nat/index, UTF16 spans/shared references, full-U32 numeric fields, default/slack/modulo, growth, truncate/reuse, captured-owner drop, partial/native primitives and affine refusal. Early checker-only same-frozen-corpus A/B BEFORE full compiler build. Predeclare rule before samples. Mandatory performance failure -> immediately checkpoint reject and restore baseline, no consumer tail. Viable -> fresh native full-root validation, actual stage1/stage2 byte equality, native/JS paired full-root timings, then all consumers only if performance remains viable. Preserve every measurement and original8192MiB/600000ms guards,ABI13,quantum64,fuel8M. No performance/whole-compiler acceptance from source review.
